preflight: 20-release low_threshold smoke on allocation 58729926 completed before full freeze; preserved separately and not used as a comparison arm.
research_question: Does a train-only low-feature hopeless-channel gate preserve paired radio quality and complete more AI units online than always-NeuralRx, with the same observed feature cost?
comparison_role: A stronger channel-aware baseline ingredient: skips only feature values below the smallest train sample decoded by either receiver. Pinned endpoints, fixed recovery, AI after radio; not the proposed joint policy.
feature: channel_estimate_power measured after release in both arms; prewarmed at worker startup
analysis: Pair by cell/index/channel seed. Cluster-bootstrap 4,000 resamples of release-level radio difference with fixed seeds 20600001 and 20600002; require lower 95% limit >= -0.5 pp and AI gain >= 0.5% in each pair. Any failure remains a failure. No additional seeds or deadline changes.
interpretation_limits: Synthetic fixed-noise P150/D130, pinned endpoints and AI after radio. This is a baseline ingredient only. Low-feature hopelessness could be a synthetic fixed-MCS artifact. No production MAC expiry, WCET, loaded queue gain or full joint-policy result.
threshold_selection: minimum train observed feature decoded by either receiver; see confirm60_low_gate_train_selection.json; test was not used to set it
